Jerash Holdings offers an impressive production capacity of more than 2.1 million pieces monthly, which adds up to more than 26 million units annually.
Twenty Years of Growth and Progress
A trusted partner for high profile global apparel brands.

Jerash Holdings manufactures and exports custom, ready-made sport and outerwear from Jordan. We make products for The North Face, Timberland, New Balance, American Eagle, Calvin Klein, and Adidas. With 7 factories and 6 warehouses employing approximately 6,600 people, our annual capacity is more than 26 million pieces.

The Jerash garment factory in Amman, Jordan is a pioneering business that researched the unique needs of refugee employees and has made accommodations, including transportation & daycare, to help scale up the hiring of Syrian women.

I want to commend the Government of Jordan for having facilitated schemes that allow Syrian refugees to have jobs. Every day, Migrants, Jordanians and Syrian refugees work sided by side at Jerash Garment factories making clothes for international brands.
United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees

Contact Jerash Holdings to learn how we can bring branded apparel to life. Our wide array of services, including embroidery, custom cut and sew, and exacting quality are what your brand needs to succeed.
Our development capabilities include converting original designs for mass-production.
